name: Moiré
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE Moiré, on demand: what changed since the baseline, shown as information (the lie detector's D3 drift, and the workspace's files not committed yet). Red only when the change report is not running; a change is never red.

facts.rerun: cd ~/virtual_workspace/lryllm/lryllm/app && env -u PYTHONPATH PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WID_ENV=localhost.rnd ~/virtual_workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "from core_engine import cebf; r = cebf.run(); print(r['at'], r['verdict'], r['pass'], 'pass', r['fail'], 'fail', r['no_data'], 'no data')"
facts.git_step: git -C ~/virtual_workspace status (the workspace must be a repository's own top and git must answer: what it prints is the fault; the lie detector cannot clear this)
facts.no_baseline_said: no baseline frozen yet (freezing one is your own act: run PIN AND RESEAL yourself, by hand in the terminal)

card.pitch: What changed, shown; red only when the report is not running
